_about: Benzene (1) + Toluene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of benzene, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of benzene, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Huang, X.[Xiaojuan], Xia, S.[Shuqian], Ma, P.[Peisheng], Song, S.[Shuang], Ma, B.[Bingjie], Vapor Liquid Equilibrium of N-Formylmorpholine with Toluene and Xylene at 101.33 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 53 (2008) 252-255
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
